title: Uniform left-inverse bound for a continuous family of injective linear maps on a compact set
statement: Let P, d ∈ ℕ, K ⊆ ℝ^d compact, and L : ℝ^d → L(ℝ^d, ℝ^P) continuous on K with L(v) injective for every v ∈ K. Then there is b ≥ 0 with |w| ≤ b|L(v)w| for all v ∈ K and w ∈ ℝ^d.
lean_statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (K : Set (Euclid d)) (L : Euclid d → (Euclid d →L[ℝ] Euclid P)), IsCompact K → ContinuousOn L K → (∀ v ∈ K, Injective (L v)) → ∃ b : ℝ, 0 ≤ b ∧ ∀ v ∈ K, ∀ w : Euclid d, ‖w‖ ≤ b * ‖L v w‖
